requirements.GC01: Guests earn no Coins and cannot spend old guest balances.
requirements.GC02: Retain old local cosmetics and normal guest PB/history saves.
requirements.RC01: Registered players receive the fixed 200-Coin clean-race bonus after accepted runs.
requirements.RC02: Preserve fixed server pricing/rewards, permanent purchases, idempotency and account/revision fences.

implementation.guests: Removed award_guest and next_guest_sequence and all app grant/debit paths. Guest balance is always zero, and purchases of locked items require sign-in. Historical guest data is read only for old owned cosmetics; its balance never imports into accounts. Guest results discard historical positive receipts.
implementation.registered: Worker passes only the verifier's literal incident_free boolean into the existing award transaction. Clean race adds fixed 200 Coins; the existing CoinReward run identity prevents duplicate grants. No new database migration beyond the original 0037 is needed.
implementation.eligibility: Existing completed five-lap telemetry supplies collision_count, off_track and elapsed ticks. The accepted trajectory's duration must match. Missing/malformed/dirty evidence earns no clean bonus and does not reject a valid score.
implementation.integrity_limit: Recorded incident facts are client evidence, not independently re-simulated collisions or tamper-proof modified-client claims. Neither client-selected amounts nor product telemetry authorize a credit.
implementation.transport: Bootstrap capability race_incident_rewards_version=1 gates optional bmt-race-incidents-v1 inside race_proof. Replay and compact trajectory encoders normalize integers and preserve samples. Older servers receive the original proof without incident metadata; existing durable payload hashes include it. No retroactive accepted-run grants.
implementation.retained: Account wallet/unlocks, fixed reward rules, 500-Coin liveries/750-Coin existing Compact parts, old fitted cosmetics, free stock/plain paint/colours/stickers, clean-car gates, native artwork/camera, PB/history, physics/scoring and concurrent work.
